assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, 75 bp SE, NextSeq 500; STAR -> HTSeq raw gene counts, 24,613 Ensembl Rn6 v93 loci (S2.6.p1, S1.p2)
sample_inclusion: 20 animals, 5 groups x 4: No SCI, TX SCI, CONT SCI, CONT SCI + SWIM, CONT SCI + SWW (S2.1.p1, TAB3). All tiny-cage housed from 3 d post-injury (S2.2.p3). PCA also shown with CONT SCI rep 3, SWIM rep 2, SWW rep 2 removed (S1.p2, FIG1) but no exclusion rule is stated.
sacrifice_time: TX 8.5 wk, No SCI and CONT SCI 11.5 wk (equivalent), SWIM and SWW 13.5 wk post-SCI (S2.3.p1, TAB1); exercise began 14 d post-injury, 5 d/wk for 10 wk (S2.2.p3)
primary_estimand: Exercise effect in contused, activity-restricted soleus: CONT SCI + SWIM vs CONT SCI and CONT SCI + SWW vs CONT SCI (Fig. 1b 'comparison of SCI alone and SCI followed by exercise'; TAB2 'effects of these two forms of exercise rehabilitation')
planned_contrasts: SWIM vs CONT (FIG1 b, S1.p2; paper: no DE result reported)
SWW vs CONT (FIG1 b, S1.p2; paper: no DE result reported)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one soleus per animal, independent animals
paper_method: not_reported for DE; DESeq2 RLE normalization and VST for PCA only (S2.6.p2, S2.6.p3)
paper_results: No DEG counts or DE gene lists. Only QC, PCA (FIG1) and mean RLE expression of top genes in four GO categories in CONT SCI vs No SCI (FIG2).
